tests.title: TC-AUTH-01: Valid User Authentication & Dashboard Redirect
tests.purpose: Validates that a verified user with valid credentials can authenticate successfully and is redirected away from the login page into the operational dashboard.
tests.precondition: Active user account exists in environment configuration (.env).
tests.action: Enters registered email and password into login inputs and clicks 'Sign In' button.
tests.expected: User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard; URL no longer contains /auth/login.
tests.assertion: Redirection completed within 15 seconds; profile avatar is displayed in top header.
tests.logs:
INFO [test_auth] Executing TC-AUTH-01: Valid user login
INFO [login_page] Entering email & password
INFO [login_page] Clicking Sign In button
INFO [login_page] Authentication successful, redirected to /dashboard

tests.title: TC-AUTH-02: Non-Existent User Credential Rejection
tests.purpose: Ensures that login attempts using an unregistered email address are rejected with an appropriate user-facing warning and no unauthorized access is permitted.
tests.precondition: Application is on Login page with empty fields.
tests.action: Enters non-existent email 'unregistered.user@example.com' with password and submits.
tests.expected: Authentication is refused, user remains on /auth/login, and error notification is displayed.
tests.assertion: URL remains on login page and error toast or message is visible.
tests.logs:
INFO [test_auth] Attempting login with non-existent user
INFO [login_page] Error notification intercepted: 'Invalid Credentials'
INFO [test_auth] Access safely blocked

tests.title: TC-AUTH-02: Valid Format Account With Incorrect Password
tests.purpose: Validates that when a valid username format is provided with an incorrect password, system security prevents unauthorized session creation.
tests.action: Enters valid user email format with wrong password 'WrongPass!999' and submits.
tests.expected: Access denied; input fields reset password; error banner appears.
tests.assertion: Session remains unauthenticated and login screen remains active.
tests.logs:
INFO [test_auth] Testing invalid password rejection
INFO [login_page] 'Invalid credentials or password' message confirmed

tests.title: TC-AUTH-02: Numeric-Only Username Rejection
tests.purpose: Verifies that non-standard numeric account handles cannot bypass authentication logic.
tests.action: Enters numeric string '9988776655' into email/username field and clicks Sign In.
tests.expected: System rejects submission and alerts user to enter valid credentials.
tests.assertion: User remains on login page with visible validation alert.

tests.title: TC-AUTH-03: Empty Form Submission & Inline Validation
tests.purpose: Verifies that submitting the login form without typing any email or password blocks network requests and displays mandatory field guidance.
tests.precondition: Application is on Login page with untouched input fields.
tests.action: Clicks 'Sign In' button directly with empty username and empty password.
tests.expected: Form submission is blocked client-side; inline warnings 'User Name Is Required' and 'Password Is Required' are shown.
tests.assertion: Both required field validation messages appear simultaneously below inputs.
tests.logs:
INFO [test_auth] Submitting blank login form
INFO [login_page] Captured inline errors: ['User Name Is Required', 'Password Is Required']

tests.title: TC-AUTH-04: Malformed Email Handling (Missing Domain & @)
tests.purpose: Verifies that malformed email strings without '@' and domain do not trigger unhandled browser errors or frontend crashes.
tests.action: Enters plain text 'plainstringuser' into email input and submits.
tests.expected: Handled gracefully with email syntax warning; no console script crash.

tests.title: TC-AUTH-04: Malformed Email Handling (Double Dot in Domain)
tests.purpose: Verifies that RFC syntax anomalies like 'user@domain..com' are sanitized and handled gracefully.
tests.assertion: Input validation triggers or authentication fails gracefully.
tests.logs: INFO [test_auth] Double dot domain boundary evaluated

tests.title: TC-AUTH-05: Maximum Length String & Unicode Resilience
tests.purpose: Ensures that high-boundary strings (128+ characters), emoji characters, and SQL/XSS symbols are safely accepted and sanitized without layout breakage.
tests.action: Enters 128-character alphanumeric string with special punctuation symbols `<>!#$%' into input fields.
tests.expected: Fields retain content without UI overflow or JavaScript errors; submission safely rejected.
tests.assertion: Field attributes remain stable, input is safely bounded.
tests.logs: INFO [test_auth] Tested 128-char boundary string & special characters

tests.title: TC-AUTH-06: Password Masking & Eye Icon Visibility Toggle
tests.purpose: Verifies that users can inspect their entered password by toggling the eye icon between masked (`password`) and plain text (`text`) modes.
tests.action: Clicks password reveal eye icon twice consecutively.
tests.expected: Input type changes from 'password' to 'text' on 1st click, and reverts to 'password' on 2nd click.
tests.assertion: Field type toggles correctly; password remains secure.
tests.logs: INFO [test_auth] Verified password toggle: password -> text -> password

tests.title: TC-AUTH-07: Forgot Password Link & Tab Redirection
tests.purpose: Validates that users who cannot remember their credentials can access the password recovery workflow.
tests.expected: Opens recovery page or tab targeted at '/auth/forgot-password'.
tests.assertion: URL contains '/auth/forgot-password' and email recovery prompt is rendered.
tests.logs: INFO [test_auth] Navigated to Forgot Password route

tests.title: TC-DASH-01: Authenticated Application Shell & Profile Check
tests.purpose: Verifies that once authenticated, the main Keepwisely CMMS dashboard renders the top navigation bar, profile badge, and operational KPI widgets.
tests.action: Inspects dashboard container, opens profile dropdown menu.
tests.expected: Dashboard shell is active, user avatar is present, and user full name is visible.
tests.assertion: Logged-in user profile name is non-empty and matches active account.
tests.logs: INFO [test_dashboard] Verified dashboard container and user menu

tests.assertion: Current URL contains '/asset' and asset grid search is visible.

tests.title: TC-DASH-03: Navigation to Breakdown Service Requests
tests.purpose: Validates that plant operators can access the Breakdown Maintenance and Service Request queue to report machine failures.
tests.expected: Browser loads /maintenance/service-request and renders the active service requests queue.

tests.title: TC-DASH-04: Navigation to Enterprise User Directory
tests.purpose: Validates that system administrators can access User Management to review employee accounts, role assignments, and department permissions.
tests.action: Selects 'User Management' from the navigation hierarchy.
tests.expected: Loads /user-management/user, displaying the employee directory and search bar.
tests.assertion: URL matches user management route and user table renders.

tests.title: TC-DASH-05: Secure User Logout & Session Invalidation
tests.purpose: Validates that when a user logs out, their active authentication tokens are invalidated and the browser redirects securely to the login portal.
tests.action: Opens profile menu and clicks 'Log Out'.
tests.expected: Session ends, stored tokens cleared, redirected to /auth/login.
tests.assertion: Current URL returns to /auth/login and login form is displayed.
tests.logs:
INFO [test_dashboard] Executing logout flow
INFO [test_dashboard] Session terminated, redirected to /auth/login

tests.title: TC-USER-01: User Directory Search & Role Filter
tests.purpose: Verifies that the user directory search bar filters employee records accurately by name, email, or department without page reload.
tests.precondition: User is on User Management page.
tests.action: Types 'admin' into search filter and verifies filtered table rows.
tests.expected: Table instantly filters to display matching users.
tests.assertion: All displayed rows contain the searched keyword.

tests.title: TC-MAINT-02: Work Order Analytics PDF SLA Export
tests.purpose: Validates that the maintenance analytics export service compiles work order history and downloads executive PDF reports within the 10-second SLA limit.
tests.precondition: User is on Maintenance Reports page with 500+ work orders selected.
tests.action: Clicks 'Generate Executive PDF Report' and awaits completion.
tests.expected: Report generator responds and triggers file download within 10.0 seconds.
tests.assertion: PDF download stream received within SLA threshold.
tests.plain_cause: The reporting server did not complete the PDF compilation within the 10-second SLA window. The background export service experienced high database query latency on historical work orders.
tests.business_impact: Medium (Performance Delay) — Maintenance managers may experience delays when pulling annual analytics reports.
tests.action_recommendation: Optimize work order indexing on the database and allocate background worker queues for large PDF compilations.
